description: This file provides retrieval and answer synthesis functions for a semantic search chatbot, utilizing a FAISS index, Django models, and configurable settings.

methods.name: List[Dict] retrieve(query: str, top_k: int | None = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the top-k relevant document chunks based on a query using a FAISS index and returns metadata including snippets.

methods.name: str synthesize_answer(query: str, sources: List[Dict])
methods.description: Generates an answer text based on retrieved sources, presenting a summarized response.

ctags.name: retrieve
ctags.pattern: /^def retrieve(query: str, top_k: int | None = None) -> List[Dict]:$/
